variables.ticket.description:
# eh run: implement `--read-only` across all five harness adapters

## Problem

Reviewer/auditor lanes driven by `eh run` should provably not mutate the checkout they examine. The read-only spike ([AI-3110](https://linear.app/alephic/issue/AI-3110)) produced a verified per-harness mapping table and a decided flag shape; this ticket implements it. Until then, orchestrators isolate lanes with disposable git worktrees — workable, but per-orchestrator machinery eh should subsume.

Blocked by [AI-3110](https://linear.app/alephic/issue/AI-3110) — do not start until its mapping table and shape decision are signed off.

## Context

* Work against `origin/main`. Mirror the structure of the approval-defaults change (#42, `d4baf2d`): a pure mapping module analogous to `src/approval-mode.ts`, wired through `buildLaunchPlan` in `src/harnesses.ts`, read in `src/headless-run.ts`, with the flag added to the `run` command in `src/main.ts`.
* The spike's committed mapping table and shape decision are the specification for per-harness args and for no-mechanism behavior. Do not re-litigate them here; if implementation reveals the table is wrong for a harness, go back through the spike doc.
* In-repo subprocess tests can only assert the *args passed* to a fake harness — they cannot prove the real harness actually blocks writes. That proof lives in the spike's live verification; this ticket's tests pin the mapping so it can't drift silently.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `eh run --read-only` maps each of the five harnesses to its verified mechanism exactly per the spike's table, via a new mapping module analogous to `src/approval-mode.ts` (not an extension of `APPROVAL_MODES` — approval and write-restriction are independent axes). Proof: per-harness subprocess tests asserting the exact args, per the `createFakeHarness` pattern.
- [ ] Invariant: a lane started with `--read-only` is never silently unrestricted — a harness the spike marked "no mechanism" behaves exactly as the spike decided (refuse to launch or loud warning, per the decision), with a test for that path.
- [ ] `--read-only` composes with `defaultApprovalMode: auto` per the spike's decided interaction (both active in one run), with a test covering the combined args.

## Out of Scope

* Interactive-mode read-only or a config-level default; `eh run` flag only.
* OS-level sandboxing beyond the harnesses' own flags.
* Re-verifying harness CLI behavior (spike owns that evidence).

## Verification

* `pnpm lint:ci`; `bun test src/headless-run.test.ts`; full `pnpm test`.
* Version bump required; update README `### Headless runs`, DESIGN.md (including the File map for the new module), `docs/qa/eh-cli.md`.
* Manual: one live probe per available harness — ask it to write a file under `--read-only` and observe refusal.

```yaml
silent_failure_cost: high
context_volatility: low
recommended_tier: high
recommended_effort: high
```
